Please first discuss this proposed API in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), since new features need approval there before an issue. For a custom display in the meantime, you can subclass `ProgressColumn`; see [progress columns](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst#columns).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
